entries.complaint: Hair and thread wind tightly around the brush roll and its ends until it stops spinning, so it has to be cut free with scissors
entries.redesign: A tapered or comb-guarded brush roll that pushes hair toward a built-in cutter, sealed end caps that hair can't wind into, and a roll that pops out without tools
entries.prior_art: Dyson conical brush bar; Shark anti-wrap rolls

entries.complaint: Sponges start to smell and harbor bacteria within days, yet most people keep them for a month or more because nothing shows when one is spent
entries.redesign: A quick-drying sponge with a color strip that fades after about a week of wetting, sold in a draining holder that keeps it off the wet sink edge

entries.complaint: The robot snags on socks, cords and rug tassels or wedges under low furniture, so owners tidy the floor before every run
entries.redesign: A front camera that recognizes and steers around small soft objects, a height sensor that checks clearance before driving under furniture, and a brush that reverses to release a snag
entries.prior_art: Camera-based obstacle avoidance on premium models

entries.complaint: Wringers leave the mop dripping or don't fit the bucket, pads fray or catch, and buckets tip and spill dirty water
entries.redesign: Separate clean and dirty tanks in a wide-based bucket, with a wringer molded into the bucket rather than clipped on, a pouring spout, and pads that attach by a full-width hook strip instead of tabs

entries.complaint: The trigger has to be held down the whole time and can't be locked on, which makes hands sore during longer cleans
entries.redesign: A click-on/click-off button with an auto-pause when the vacuum stands upright or the floor head lifts off the floor, so battery is saved without a held trigger
entries.prior_art: Stick vacuums with on/off switches; Dyson's later button models

entries.complaint: The battery is built in, runs far short of the box claim on max power, and when it wears out replacing the whole vacuum is cheaper
entries.redesign: A battery that clicks out with standard cells, runtime printed for each power mode (not only eco), and a spare battery that charges in the dock
entries.prior_art: Click-in removable batteries on some stick vacuums

entries.complaint: Nozzles clog with dried cleaner, seals wear so the trigger sputters, and the last inch can't be sprayed because the tube no longer reaches
entries.redesign: A weighted pickup tube that follows the liquid to the lowest point, a nozzle that closes when you twist it off, and a trigger head that unscrews to move onto a refill bottle
